Q6156.reason: The deposition qualifies as former testimony because the engineer is unavailable and the company had an opportunity and similar motive to develop his testimony in the prior action.

Q8413.reason: The European Court of Human Rights held that state immunity did not violate Article 6, so immunity prevailed over the claimed right of access to a court.
